meta.name: enrich-ioc
meta.description: Enrich an IOC (IP, domain, hash, URL) with threat intelligence. Use when you need to look up reputation and context for an indicator using GTI and SIEM. Returns threat intel findings, SIEM entity summary, and IOC match status.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询IP、域名、哈希等威胁情报
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速获取IOC的威胁情报和上下文。
copy.tagline_en: Look up threat intelligence for IPs, domains, hashes, and URLs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly enrich IOCs with threat intelligence and context.

howto.what: 装上后，当你提供一个IOC（IP、域名、文件哈希或URL）时，Claude会利用Google Threat Intelligence (GTI)和Chronicle SIEM查询该指标的声誉、上下文和匹配状态，并输出威胁评分和恶意置信度。
howto.when: 当你请求查询某个IOC的威胁情报或需要分析其声誉和上下文时触发。例如：查询一个IP地址、域名、文件哈希或URL。

say.text: 分析evil-domain.com这个域名是否恶意。
say.note: 会返回域名的GTI分类、关联的恶意软件家族等。

howto.what_en: When you provide an IOC (IP, domain, file hash, or URL), Claude enriches it using Google Threat Intelligence (GTI) and Chronicle SIEM, returning threat intelligence findings, SIEM entity summary, IOC match status, threat score, and malicious confidence.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to enrich an IOC (e.g., IP, domain, hash, URL) for reputation and context using GTI and SIEM.

say_en.text: Query threat intelligence for IP address 198.51.100.10.
say_en.note: Claude will fetch GTI report and SIEM context for that IP.
Returns GTI classification and associated malware families.
